description: You are an electronics officer aboard a vessel that has experienced multiple instrument malfunctions after an electrical surge. Bridge Command is running with a corrupted configuration and a broken scenario. You must diagnose and repair ALL faults. The ship's normal operating parameters are documented in /home/ga/Documents/vessel_specs.txt (this file will be created during setup). There are exactly 6 faults spread across the bc5.ini configuration file AND the active scenario files. You must: (1) Identify and fix all configuration faults in bc5.ini (the settings editor 'Settings: Main' can be used, or edit files directly). (2) Identify and fix all scenario faults in the scenario at '/opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/m) Portsmouth Approach Custom/'. (3) Write a detailed fault diagnosis report to /home/ga/Documents/fault_report.txt listing each fault found, its location, the incorrect value, the corrected value, and the likely cause. The report must describe all 6 faults. Do NOT simply restore from backup — you must demonstrate understanding by writing the diagnosis report. Login: ga / password123.
